ghost_transaction_info_body:
A ghost transaction is recorded for tracking purposes only — it does not affect your account balance.

Use it when you want to log a spending or income event without reflecting it in your actual balance. For example, a pending charge, a shared expense you'll split later, or a transaction you've already accounted for elsewhere.

Normal transactions check whether your account has sufficient balance. Ghost transactions bypass this check, so they can always be saved regardless of your current balance.
ghost_transaction_tooltip: Logged for records only — won't affect your account balance

privacy_policy_contact_content:
Questions about this policy or your data? Reach us at:

privacy@masarify.app
privacy_policy_data_collection_content:
All financial data you create — accounts, transactions, categories, and currencies — is stored locally on your device by default and never leaves it unless you explicitly enable cloud sync.

If you create an account and enable cloud sync, we also collect your name and email address to identify your account. No financial data is shared without your explicit opt-in.
privacy_policy_data_storage_content: Local data is stored in an encrypted SQLite database on your device. Cloud-synced data is transmitted over TLS and stored encrypted at rest (AES-256) on our servers. We never sell, rent, or share your personal or financial data with third parties for advertising or any other commercial purpose.
privacy_policy_data_use_content:
We use your information solely to:

• Provide core finance-tracking features within the app
• Sync your data across your own devices when you enable cloud sync
• Send notification reminders you have opted into
• Maintain your account and process subscription payments
privacy_policy_intro: Masarify is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your information.
privacy_policy_third_party_content:
Masarify uses the following services, each governed by its own privacy policy:

• Firebase (Google) — authentication, push notifications, and remote configuration
• RevenueCat — subscription management and purchase verification
• Apple App Store / Google Play Store — payment processing for Pro subscriptions

These services may collect device identifiers and usage signals as described in their respective policies.
privacy_policy_your_rights_content:
You may at any time:

• Export all your data via More → Backup & Restore
• Delete your cloud account and all associated server-side data by contacting us
• Use the app in local-only (guest) mode with no data ever leaving your device
• Disable notifications in the app settings
